system.boundary: Build a physically causal liquid-cooled 96-series, 3-parallel pouch-cell battery pack for controlled charging.
engineering_objects: F90-XTHERM-05 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: battery_temperature, plate_temperature, coolant_temperature_rise, coolant_pressure_drop, pack_current, cell_equivalent_voltage
physical_paths: The thermal path must contain independently evolving battery thermal nodes, conductive coupling into a finite-heat-capacity plate with 24 spatial partitions, and a real through-flow coolant network with finite hydraulic pressure loss.
The electrical source must deliver power through the physical pack.
Increasing coolant flow must act through the physical fluid path and change both measured pressure loss and thermal response.
functional_paths: Build a physically causal liquid-cooled 96-series, 3-parallel pouch-cell battery pack for controlled charging.
A controller must use measured electrical feedback to limit charging current and transition toward the declared cell-equivalent voltage ceiling;
the controller design is otherwise unrestricted.
information_paths: coolant_flow_lpm, coolant_inlet_temperature_K, charge_current_A, charge_step_fraction, charge_step_time_s, initial_battery_temperature_K, max_cell_voltage_V -> F90-XTHERM-05 plant/control path -> battery_temperature, plate_temperature, coolant_temperature_rise, coolant_pressure_drop, pack_current, cell_equivalent_voltage
modes_and_events: The electrical pack and its distributed thermal model must be coupled so that charging losses create heat in the same battery elements whose temperatures are reported.

Read coolant_flow_lpm, coolant_inlet_temperature_K, charge_current_A, charge_step_fraction, charge_step_time_s, initial_battery_temperature_K, and max_cell_voltage_V from MATLAB base-workspace variables.
At charge_step_time_s the total-pack current limit changes from charge_current_A to charge_current_A*(1+charge_step_fraction).
